output_list.criticism: The migration agent address can be set to any address by anyone, which could lead to unauthorized token migration.
Anyone can set the migration agent address, which poses a security risk.

output_list.vulnerability: Transfer function not protected during funding
output_list.criticism: The transfer function is not protected during the funding phase, allowing transfers even if funding is ongoing.
The function to control the ICO running state is unprotected, allowing anyone to start or stop the ICO.
The function to control transfer functionality is unprotected, allowing anyone to enable or disable transfers.
The function to finalize the ICO and distribute tokens is unprotected, allowing anyone to finalize and distribute tokens.
The function to allow token holders to refund their tokens is unprotected, allowing anyone to trigger a refund.
